responsibility: Implements GCC’s DWARF2 call frame information generation and the RTL pass that derives unwind state from frame-related instructions. This file models per-trace and per-row CFA/register-save state, interprets prologue/epilogue frame notes into DW_CFA operations, emits .cfi directives or equivalent CFI records, decides when EH frame or debug-frame information should be produced on the current target, and defines the pass_dwarf2_frame RTL pass that runs after frame layout to compute canonical unwind annotations for debuggers and exception handling.
